cases.question: Under the current Nova policy, how many times can an approval be used and when does it expire?
cases.answer:
Under the current Nova policy, an approval can be used only once and expires after five minutes. [1]

(Note: The question does not ask about delegation, which is not specified in the current policy.)

citations.text: Nova approval policy version 2 is the current approved rule and supersedes version 1. Under version 2, each approval may be used only once and expires after five minutes. Delegation is not specified in this policy.
Nova approval policy version 1 was a historical draft. In version 1, an approval could be reused until it expired after 30 minutes. Version 1 is superseded and is not the current rule.

cases.question: According to Nova policy version 1, could an approval be reused and how long did it last?
cases.answer: According to Nova policy version 1, an approval could be reused until it expired. The approval would last for 30 minutes. [1]
